description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, including path handling, string replacement, number parsing, and string splitting, as well as operator overloads and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: StripBasename
methods.description: Removes directory path from a full file path, returning only the filename.

methods.name: ExcludeFileExtension
methods.description: Removes the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: _strFromWide
methods.description: Converts a wide string (UTF-16) to a UTF-8 encoded string stream, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: _str
methods.description: Converts wide C-string, wide character, or wide string to a string stream.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a SourceLocation object to a stream, showing function, file, and line.

methods.name: ReplaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another string.

methods.name: tryToNumber<int64_t>
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string or C-string into a 64-bit integer, returning std::nullopt if invalid.

methods.name: tryToNumber<double>
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string or C-string into a double, returning std::nullopt if invalid.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string view into a vector of string views based on a delimiter.
